answers.denseVsLexical: dense materially outperforms the no-model lexical baseline on MRR, Hit@10, and latency-adjusted quality; lexical remains a lower-resource fallback.
answers.strongestLexical: lexical-bm25-k1-1.5-b-0.75 was selected on DEV; HOLDOUT does not retune lexical parameters.
answers.uniqueLexicalRecall: no incremental relevant candidate was contributed by the selected lexical leg in controlled hybrid HOLDOUT; lexical-only still retrieved relevant candidates that dense did not, but with materially lower ranking quality.
answers.fusion: legacy-weighted-rank remains stronger than the selected RRF and DBSF controls on HOLDOUT; no fusion replacement is justified (0.4885 RRF MRR, 0.5425 DBSF MRR versus 0.6896 legacy MRR).
answers.reranker: reranking improves MRR for dense and selected fusion but lowers Hit@10 and adds substantial latency; lexical reranking is not attractive in this evidence.
answers.lowResource: lexical-only avoids query embeddings but has materially lower quality and remains a fallback rather than the default.
answers.default: recommend dense as the v0.1 default under the frozen paired-delta rule and lower latency; keep hybrid-legacy as a compatibility and explicit profile option, with reranking opt-in.

frozenRule.pairedInterval: 95% bootstrap interval for per-query candidate-minus-baseline deltas must exclude zero
